text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, D and E early, then buying B and D back at higher prices, showed me that taking profits without a plan can mean missing gains and paying more to re-enter.","I added to Stock B and D after their prices had risen; before buying more, I should check position size and whether the investment still fits my overall allocation, rather than chasing recent momentum.","Selling Stock E at a large loss after buying it back reminded me to set clear reasons for holding or selling before I trade, and to review those reasons instead of letting regret or a separate-account mindset drive the decision."]}
